critique_summary: This hypothesis proposes a reasonable extension of existing weight-sharing NAS methods. The adaptive allocation idea has some novelty but is not entirely unprecedented. Feasibility is high given existing supernet implementations. Potential impact is moderate - improvements in NAS efficiency are valuable but incremental.

issues.issue: The similarity metric for adaptive weight allocation needs careful design to avoid computational overhead that negates efficiency gains
Comparison should include recent one-shot NAS baselines, not just random search
